The '''Yde system''' was located within [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was situated [[Nicandra sector/Legends|Nicandra sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and contained the location [[Yde]].<ref name="Fry">{{PlanetSystemNames}}</ref>

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
Yde contained the location [[Desultori]] which was the home of the noted [[Author/Legends|author]], inventor and scholar [[Aanxi Raanxi Laanxi]], as well as the [[University of Desultori]], where Laanxi chaired four subcommittees on [[creative procrastinating]].<ref name="MAGL">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Yde system was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]],'' a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] that placed the system in grid square M-7.<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
